why: Rounds 1/2 tested only on six historically exposed topics. Round 3 tests on fresh topics never generated, captured or scored before.
reserve_rule: A fresh topic yielding fewer than 16 parsed sentences is skipped and the next reserve topic is used, in order.

sentence_generation.prompt: Write 24 different short English sentences about {topic}. Write one sentence per line. Do not number them.
sentence_generation.parse: scripts/action_jepa_round3.py parse_sentences (3-25 words, ends . ! ?, dedupe, first 24)

action_generation: same model, the four prompts of bench-results/jepa-action-20261010/gen_actions.py, temperature 0, max_tokens 48, first line

capture.runner: llama.cpp b10964 release ubuntu-x64 tarball sha256 9abf88aea48a55d0f80edb1ee20220b186848cca0b4e919d71518cfd7ca67443
capture.rows: all 1875 old rows plus all fresh rows in one runtime (release build differs from the earlier local build: 48 control rows max abs diff 1.9e-3, cos >= .99991; not mixed)

partitions.test: fresh topics only; historical test topics not used
partitions.exclusion: drop fresh episodes whose normalized input/output text appears in any non-test row; dedupe fresh inputs

training.arm_round1: scripts/action_jepa_objective.py, steps 240 dim 16 lr .02 max_update_norm .05 ema .99 retention_max_delta 0
training.arm_round2: scripts/action_jepa_residual_candidate.py, steps grid 240,960 chosen on calibration, same other config

gates: unchanged original gates; per seed and arm candidate_gate_pass reported; no test-based selection
